args:
import importlib.util
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from lxml import etree

test_path = Path(r"C:\checkouts\sre_convertor\tests\test_rtc_writer.py")
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("rtc_writer_test_module", test_path)
assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
summary, network, structures, runtime = module._synthetic_case()
compilation = module.compile_sre_rtc(summary, network, structures, runtime)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
    package = Path(directory) / "rtc"
    module.write_sre_rtc_package(compilation, package, Path(directory) / "dflowfm")
    xml_dir = package / "xml_dir"
    xsd_dir = package / "xsd_dir"
    validated = []
    parsed = []
    for xml_path in sorted(xml_dir.glob("*.xml")):
        document = etree.parse(str(xml_path))
        parsed.append(xml_path.name)
        xsd_path = xsd_dir / f"{xml_path.stem}.xsd"
        if xsd_path.is_file():
            schema = etree.XMLSchema(etree.parse(str(xsd_path)))
            schema.assertValid(document)
            validated.append(xml_path.name)
    print(f"Parsed XML: {', '.join(parsed)}")
    print(f"XSD-validated XML: {', '.join(validated)}")
